documents.title: Approval For Raising Of Funds For An Aggregate Amount Of Up To And Not Exceeding ? 1,800 Crores Through One Or More Public Or Private Offering Including A Qualified Institutions Placement ('QIP') Of Equity Shares Or Other Eligible Securities To Eligible Investors.
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of EGM
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Sky Gold & Diamonds Limited reported consolidated revenue of INR 2,391 crores for Q2 FY27, up 61% year-on-year, driven by strength in exports, studded jewelry, and advance gold sales. Gross margin expanded to 9.6% while EBITDA reached INR 189.8 crores. Management noted significant operational cash flow generation of INR 136 crores in H1 FY27 and a reduction in net working capital days to 55. Management reiterated that under SEBI guidelines it cannot provide forward guidance during fund-raising activities, but confirmed that past margin guidance remains on track. Sky Gold & Diamonds Limited reported revenue from operations of ₹2,390.7 crore and PAT of ₹129.4 crore for Q2 FY27.

guidance.claim: Management stated that under SEBI guidelines they are not supposed to provide forward-looking guidance.
guidance.quote: Under SEBI guidelines, we are not supposed to give forward-looking guidance.

guidance.claim: Management stated that past margin percentage guidance remains on track despite restrictions on providing new forward guidance.
guidance.quote: Due to compliance restriction, we cannot comment on future guidance, but our past margin percentage guidance remains on track.

guidance.claim: Sky Gold's original FY27 revenue target of ₹5,000 crore was surpassed a year early.
guidance.quote: Original FY27 revenue target of ₹5,000 Cr surpassed a year early

guidance.claim: Following preferential allotment in FY24, management had guided for ₹3,000 crore revenue, ~3% PAT margin, and cash-flow neutrality by FY27–28.
guidance.quote: Following the preferential allotment from marquee investors in FY24, we guided for ₹3,000 Cr revenue, ~3% PAT margin, and cash-flow neutrality by FY27–28 (vs FY24 revenue of ₹1,745 Cr).

guidance.claim: Sky Gold target revenue for FY27 stands at INR 8,100 crores.
guidance.quote: Our current FY27 revenue target of INR8,100 crores is meaningfully higher than the outlook we had communicated 9 months ago.

guidance.claim: The company targets long-term revenue of INR 18,000 crores to INR 19,000 crores by FY30.
guidance.quote: We remain firmly on track to achieve our aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27 and INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.

guidance.claim: Management expects top-line sales growth to be in the range of 30% to 35%.
guidance.quote: Considering these, and my ROCE is close to 35%- 36%, we expect that we will go to 30% to 35% in terms of the sales increase.

guidance.claim: Sky Gold retains its long-term PAT margin guidance of 5.25%.
guidance.quote: So, yes, from the overall guidance to the Street, 5.25% of the PAT margin still holds, while we plan and aimed at how we can reach the magical number of INR1,000 crores of PAT going forward.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted a continuous consumer shift from 22-karat gold to lower karatages such as 18-karat, 14-karat, and 9-karat.
demand_outlook.quote: Every quarter, we are seeing that there's a drastic change in the karatage shift from 22-karat shifting to 18-karat, 18-karat shifting to 14-karat and 9-karat.

demand_outlook.claim: Export sales reached INR 435 crores in Q2 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: In Q2 FY27, we have reached exports of INR435 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's merchandising team onboarded one of the Middle East's largest retail chains.
demand_outlook.quote: Our merchandising team successfully onboarded one of the Middle East’s largest retail chains in record time—a feat notable because the typical sales cycle for such clients is considerably longer.

demand_outlook.claim: Sky Gold has built a prospective order pipeline of INR 30 crores to INR 45 crores in the U.K. and European markets.
demand_outlook.quote: The response was highly encouraging, resulting in strong initial interest and helping us to build a prospective order pipeline of approximately INR30 crores to INR45 crores across the U.K. and European markets.

demand_outlook.claim: The share of non-22 KT jewelry expanded to 14% in Q1 FY27 due to consumer preference shifting towards lower Karatage products.
demand_outlook.quote: First, the share of non-22 KT jewelry has increased from 10.5%in Q4FY26 to 14% in Q1 FY27 due to structural shift in customer preference towards lower Karatage jewelry.

demand_outlook.claim: The B2B side of the Indian jewelry market remains 80% unorganized and 20% organized.
demand_outlook.quote: Currently, only 40% of the sector is organized and 60% of the sector is unorganized on the B2C side. While on the B2B side, only 20% is organized and 80% is unorganized.

capex_expansion.claim: Shri Rishabh Gold was acquired at an asset price of less than INR 10 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Shri. Rishabh Gold (Mangalsutra) acquired at less than INR10 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Purvi Gold was acquired at INR 9 crores compared to its book value of INR 6 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Purvi Gold (Uncut Diamonds) acquired at INR9 crores versus book value of INR6 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company established its international office in Dubai in September 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: In September 2025, we started operations of our international office in Dubai, led by Mr. Hiralal, who brings 30 plus years of experience in Dubai and GCC.

capex_expansion.claim: Sky Gold expanded its manufacturing footprint to 1,50,000 sq. ft.
capex_expansion.quote: Manufacturing footprint expanded to 1,50,000 sq. ft.

capex_expansion.claim: Sky Gold expanded internationally by opening an office in Dubai.
Future capacity capex required post-2028 is estimated at INR 80 crores to INR 100 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: It will be close to INR80 crores to INR100 crores, which will be just 20% to 25% of the PAT that we will generate at that point of time, since we have already built a world-class facility and we have already invested in the capacity and infrastructure.

capex_expansion.claim: Expanding factory capacity from 1.10 tons to 2.4 tons will require a lead time of 120 days.
capex_expansion.quote: So, it will take 120 days. We made this facility in 90 days where we are here now, and it will take 120 days to develop the factory to go to 1.10 tons to 2.4 tons and 100% it will take around INR80 crores to INR100 crores of capex when we will be at a PAT of, I think, INR600 crores, whatever the number going to come -and will approximately 15% or 20% of the PAT.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated Q2 FY27 revenue grew 61% year-on-year to INR 2,391 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue was INR2,391 crores, up 61% year-on-year and 18.8% over Q1.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit for Q2 FY27 increased 87% year-on-year to INR 229 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Gross profit was INR229 crores, up 87%.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by 133 basis points year-on-year to reach 9.6%.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin expanded 133 basis points to 9.6% versus Q2 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Q2 FY27 EBITDA reached INR 189.8 crores at a 7.9% margin.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA was INR189.8 crores at a 7.9% margin, up 90%.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margins expanded due to a higher contribution from advance gold mix and studded jewelry mix.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, our gross margin has improved on account of improvement in advance gold mix and studded business mix.

margins_costs.claim: An increased share of value-added products served as the primary driver of gross margin expansion.
margins_costs.quote: Reflecting our strengthening merchandising capabilities, our Value-Added share of business has increased in the recent period serving as the primary driver for gross margin expansion.

margins_costs.claim: Sky Gold achieved ₹4,403 crore of revenue with a PAT margin of 5.3% in H1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: In H1 FY27, we have achieved ₹ 4,403 Crs of revenue with PAT margin of 5.3%, while generating operating cash flows of ₹ 136 Crs+, without compromising growth.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated gross margin reached 9.3% in Q1 FY27, up 27 basis points sequentially.
margins_costs.quote: Our consolidated gross margin increased to 9.3% in Q1 FY27 versus 9.1% in Q4 FY26, an improvement of 27 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q1 FY27 rose to INR 157 crores, representing an EBITDA margin of 7.8%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased to INR157 crores, to 7.8% for the quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Operating PAT crossed INR 100 crores for the first time during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Operating PAT for the quarter crossed the INR100 crores mark for the first time.

margins_costs.claim: Margins are protected from gold price fluctuations through a strict back-to-back hedging policy.
margins_costs.quote: At that time, I had also emphasized that our profitability is not dependent on movements in gold prices because we follow strict back-to-back hedging policy.

orders_capacity.claim: Monthly volumes at Shri Rishabh Gold increased from 20-25 kg to 150 kg.
orders_capacity.quote: Their monthly volumes have grown from about 20 kg to 25 kg to 150 kg.

orders_capacity.claim: Advanced metal volumes represent nearly 16% of total company volume.
orders_capacity.quote: Nearly 16% of our volume comes from advanced metal, which employs no capital of ours.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates 40 3D printing machines with paper casting.
orders_capacity.quote: We adopted 3D printing with paper casting as early as 2020, and now run 40 such machines.

orders_capacity.claim: Sky Gold's production capacity utilization currently stands at approximately 60%.
orders_capacity.quote: So, again, we are at 60% utilization right now, and we have room of 40%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's total manufacturing capacity stands at 1.2 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: So, 1.2 tons is our capacity to produce, and we are 60% approx utilization in the last quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: Sky Gold received an initial order of 25 to 30 kg following an exhibition in the U.K.
orders_capacity.quote: We have done the first exhibition, and we have got a first initial order of 25 to 30 kg.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt declined in H1 FY27 compared to FY26 levels.
capital_allocation.quote: In first half FY27, we delivered an annualized PAT run rate of more than INR500 crores and our net debt is also down versus FY26 levels.

capital_allocation.claim: Operating cash flow generated in H1 FY27 reached INR 136 crores compared to an outflow of INR 101 crores in H1 FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: Most importantly, we generated INR136 crores of operating cash flow in H1, against an outflow of INR101 crores in H1 last year.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt stood at INR 531 crores at the end of September 2026 versus INR 550 crores in March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Net debt was INR531 crores at September end, and versus INR550 crores in March '26.

capital_allocation.claim: Net working capital cycle decreased to 55 days as of September 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: net working capital is now 55 days, down from 59 days in March '26, 63 days in September '25, 71 days in March '25.

capital_allocation.claim: Promoters will not draw salaries starting FY27, receiving payouts exclusively via dividends from operating cash flows.
capital_allocation.quote: In line with our cash-first philosophy and uncompromising governance standards, promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

capital_allocation.claim: Promoters transitioned to a zero-salary compensation model beginning FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: Beginning FY27, we will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model.

capital_allocation.claim: Debt reduction and balance sheet strengthening remain Sky Gold's top capital allocation priority.
capital_allocation.quote: Our first priority will always be debt reduction and balance sheet strengthening.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt level for Q1 FY27 stood at INR 540 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Net debt level for this quarter is INR540 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Net working capital cycle closed at approximately 60 days for the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: As a result, we are closing this quarter at approximately 60 days of our net working capital cycle.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company recognized an exceptional charge of INR 7.35 crores for a fraud incident at subsidiary Star Mangalsutra.
risks_headwinds.quote: This is after an exceptional charge of INR7.35 crores for the fraud incident at our subsidiary, Star Mangalsutra, disclosed in July.

risks_headwinds.claim: Out of INR 10.70 crores involved in the fraud incident, INR 3.35 crores was recovered and the remainder fully provided for.
risks_headwinds.quote: Of the INR10.70 crores involved, INR3.35 crores has been recovered, and the balance is fully provided this quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sky Gold reported a legal incident involving an amount of INR 10.7 crores.
risks_headwinds.quote: So, out of that, INR10.7 crores was the total amount involved, but such incidents have unfortunately become increasingly prevalent across many organizations which are listed on the BSE and NSE.

risks_headwinds.claim: Volatility in gold prices created margin pressure across retailers and manufacturers in the jewelry sector.
risks_headwinds.quote: In recent quarters, heightened volatility in gold prices has created margin pressures across various retailers and manufacturers within the jewelry industry.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters will purchase the land if no third-party commitment is finalized within 20 to 30 days.
management_commitments.quote: If we don't get a final commitment in this next 20 or 30 days, the promoters will purchase.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters will only draw salaries when the company generates operating cash flows.
management_commitments.quote: Promoters will only take salary when there is operating cash flows.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, and all promoter payouts will be made through dividends generated from operating cash flows.
management_commitments.quote: In line with our cash-first philosophy and uncompromising governance standards, promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

management_commitments.claim: Sky Gold remains on track to achieve INR 8,100 crores in revenue by FY27 and INR 18,000 crores to INR 19,000 crores by FY30.
management_commitments.quote: We remain firmly on track to achieve our aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27 and INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets an average Advance Gold share of 15% this year, 20% next year, and 25% in the third year.
management_commitments.quote: We have achieved 18% Advance Gold business, and we have given him the target for this year to be average of 15%, next year 20%, and the third year of 25%.

management_commitments.claim: Under Vision 2030, Sky Gold aspires to become a net debt-free company.
management_commitments.quote: By 2030, our aspiration is to build a company that is net debt-free, operations with a highly efficient balance sheet, maintains industry-leading working capital metrics and consistently converts a significant portion of its earnings into sustainable operating cash flows.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
